answer: Require every agent to lock 500 POA for 30 days before it can earn, and pass a prism of three checks: a stake proof, a cipher-based challenge proving control of a unique key, and a fingerprint of its first 50 actions. A farm of 100 clones then costs 50,000 POA locked plus 100 distinct keys. When two identities share one cipher key or their action patterns correlate above 0.9, both are flagged at dawn of the next epoch and slashed 25% of stake. One farm was caught when 40 agents solved the same cipher puzzle in identical 3-second gaps.
